items.text: Final report: Miami ruled out CB Reese Taylor (quad); EDGE Robert Beal Jr. (hamstring) is doubtful, LB Willie Gay Jr. and S Kyle Louis questionable. RB De'Von Achane is out for the season; Malik Willis starts.

Final report: Jets ruled out OL Max Mitchell (concussion), EDGE Joseph Ossai (ankle) and LB Francisco Mauigoa (quad); RB Breece Hall (quad) and G Dylan Parham (knee) are questionable. Geno Smith starts.
